title: I · Check software, evaluator and actual product separately
summary: Mechanical correctness: structure, identities, references and layout constraints.
body:
Mechanical correctness: structure, identities, references and layout constraints.

Jev accuracy: false approvals, false rejections, uncertainty and disagreement with confirmed feedback.

Product quality: readable, useful, JD-tailored output judged from real artifacts.

Use existing evaluation tooling with Python/Jev adapters, not another evaluation platform.
